translations.web: She said, “Behold, your sister-in-law has gone back to her people and to her god. Follow your sister-in-law.”
translations.bsb: “Look,” said Naomi, “your sister-in-law has gone back to her people and her gods; follow her back home.”
translations.kjv: And she said, Behold, thy sister in law is gone back unto her people, and unto her gods: return thou after thy sister in law.
translations.asv: And she said, Behold, thy sister-in-law is gone back unto her people, and unto her god: return thou after thy sister-in-law.
